correctness.rationale: The unique gap-necklace encoding (positive zero-gaps between successive ones) preserves rotations, including imprimitive necklaces. Window accounting gives A+4B+3G+2E=n and all eight constrained gram counts. Burnside rotations with repetition d, multinomial gap types and stars-and-bars excess distribute every feasible fiber. Singleton cases follow from changes in cyclic type orders or long-gap excess. Rational generating functions and their uncancelled cyclotomic poles imply least periods 12 and 6. Independent literal four-gram enumeration checked all admissible necklaces for every n<=14, including n<4 wraparound and first ambiguity at n=9.
